verdict.rationale: Mintlify exposes a REST API for deployments/analytics/assistant embedding, an admin MCP server with write access (edit pages, update settings, open PRs) mirroring editor capabilities, and a CLI for local preview/build/export, giving strong programmatic parity for content and automation tasks. However, several UI-only capabilities (custom domain/DNS setup, analytics dashboard exploration, search boost configuration, self-host deployment orchestration) have no documented API equivalents, and the docs.mintlify.com/openapi.json probe 404s, so there's no single canonical machine-readable API spec proving full parity. missing for 10: documented API/MCP coverage for domain/DNS management, analytics dashboard querying beyond export, search ranking configuration, and a discoverable OpenAPI spec confirming complete UI-to-API parity.
